answer_1.quote: text style transfer ... has become a research hotspot in natural language generation ...

answer_2.quote: we use the pre-trained style classifier to calculate the transfer accuracy of output sentences... we compute the BLEU scores of output sentences to measure content preservation.

answer_4.quote: We invite 3 annotators with linguistic background to evaluate the output sentences... annotators are required to score each aspect of sentences from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each aspect (transfer accuracy, content preservation, fluency) on a 1‑5 scale.
